Concluded the two prerequisite gaps to build first are trajectory outcome labeling and injection hit-tracking, before any rule lifecycle/gated promotion can work.

turns.title: Resolved rule-injection strategy: full-inject small corpus, graduate hooks

Resolved that at the small scale mnemo operates at (dozens of rules), full-corpus injection is sufficient — no conditional push needed, matching happens via the reader recognizing sharp trigger phrasing. Added a new lifecycle exit: confirmed rules with observable triggers should graduate out of memory into hooks/CI rather than stay pushed, complementing the refutation-based exit from [T8198].
